questions.question: Verify the claim that Grassmann studied Chinese. Reliable biographies confirm his independent study of Sanskrit and other Indo-European languages, while his involvement in a missionary society concerned China may be a separate fact. Remove Chinese from RU/EN unless a source confirms the language study.
